proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Please provide a small, shareable sample of `products.csv` (5–20 rows) that reproduces the conversion error, the exact error message including any stack or source lines, and confirm whether the file has a header row, field delimiter, text quote, and file encoding. A minimal reproducible CSV and the exact error will let us follow the failure locally.
proposal.rationale: The report omits the CSV contents and the exact error message; without sample input and the full error we cannot reproduce or diagnose the conversion failure.
